/*DASHBOARD-1340 user: sudhir.kumar@zeptonow.com*/SELECT `city` AS `city`,
       `contract_type` AS `contract_type`,
       `vehicle_type` AS `vehicle_type`,
       `saturday` AS `saturday`,
       `sunday` AS `sunday`
FROM
  (SELECT city,
          contract_type,
          vehicle_type,
          sum(case
                  when week_Day = 7 then a
              end) as Saturday,
          sum(case
                  when week_Day = 1 then a
              end) as Sunday
   from
     (SELECT login_date,
             dayofweek(login_Date) as week_day,
             c.name as city,
             r.contract_Type,
             r.vehicle_type,
             count(DISTINCT s.vendor_Rider_id) as a
      from gold.ops.lm_daily_rider_summary s
      left join silver.oms.rider r on s.vendor_Rider_id = r.vendor_Rider_id
      left join silver.oms.city c on s.city_id = c.id
      where login_Date > current_Date - 8
        and dayofweek(login_Date) in (1,
                                      7)
      group by 1,
               2,
               3,
               4,
               5)
   group by 1,
            2,
            3) AS `virtual_table`
ORDER BY `city` ASC,
         `contract_type` ASC,
         `vehicle_type` ASC
LIMIT 1000

       `saturday` AS `saturday`,
       `sunday` AS `sunday`
FROM
  (SELECT city,
          contract_type,
          vehicle_type,
          sum(case
                  when week_Day = 7 then a
              end) as Saturday,
          sum(case
                  when week_Day = 1 then a
              end) as Sunday
   from
     (SELECT login_date,
             dayofweek(login_Date) as week_day,
             c.name as city,
             r.contract_Type,
             r.vehicle_type,
             count(DISTINCT s.vendor_Rider_id) as a
      from gold.ops.lm_daily_rider_summary s
      left join silver.oms.rider r on s.vendor_Rider_id = r.vendor_Rider_id
      left join silver.oms.city c on s.city_id = c.id
      where login_Date > current_Date - 8

                                      7)
      group by 1,
               2,
               3,
               4,
               5)
   group by 1,
            2,
            3) AS `virtual_table`
ORDER BY `city` ASC,
         `contract_type` ASC,
         `vehicle_type` ASC
LIMIT 1000

       `saturday` AS `saturday`,

FROM
  (SELECT city,
          contract_type,
          vehicle_type,
          sum(case
                  when week_Day = 7 then a
              end) as Saturday,
          sum(case
                  when week_Day = 1 then a
              end) as Sunday
   from
     (SELECT login_date,
             dayofweek(login_Date) as week_day,
             c.name as city,
             r.contract_Type,
             r.vehicle_type,
             count(DISTINCT s.vendor_Rider_id) as a
      from gold.ops.lm_daily_rider_summary s
      left join silver.oms.rider r on s.vendor_Rider_id = r.vendor_Rider_id
      left join silver.oms.city c on s.city_id = c.id
      where login_Date > current_Date - 8

                                      7)
      group by 1,
               2,
               3,
               4,
               5)
   group by 1,
            2,
            3) AS `virtual_table`
ORDER BY `city` ASC,
         `contract_type` ASC,
         `vehicle_type` ASC
LIMIT 1000
